description_en: Queries the near-origin traffic diversion configurations of an Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instance in the Chinese mainland
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防（中国内地）实例的近源流量压制配置
name: DescribeBlockStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query for near-origin traffic diversion configurations.
You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询近源流量压制配置的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_ids

StatusList.description_en: The near-origin traffic diversion configurations of the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instances
StatusList.description_zh: DDoS高防实例的近源流量压制配置

BlockStatus.description_en:
The traffic blocking status. Valid values:
areablock: Blocked.
normal: Normal (not blocked)
BlockStatus.description_zh:
流量封禁状态。取值：
areablock：表示封禁中。
normal：表示正常（未封禁）

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the blocking. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 封禁结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒

Line.description_en:
The type of the blocked line. Valid values:
ct: China Telecom international line.
cut: China Unicom international line
Line.description_zh:
封禁线路类型。取值：
ct：表示电信海外线路。
cut：表示联通海外线路

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the blocking. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 封禁开始时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instance
